questions.question: Find the ODD one out.
questions.questionHtml: Find the ODD one out.
questions.solution:
Sphere : perfectly round, no edges or vertices

Cone : has a circular base and a pointed vertex

Cylinder : two circular bases, no vertices

Cube : six square faces, flat surfaces , edges, and vertices

✅ Odd one out: Cube

Why? All others (Sphere, Cone, Cylinder) have curved surfaces , while Cube has only flat faces and straight edges .

Correct answer: Cube

questions.question: Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group? M N O P : N M O P A B C D : B A C D F G H I : G F H I S T U V : T S U V W X Y Z : X Y W Z
questions.questionHtml:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

M N O P : N M O P

A B C D : B A C D

F G H I : G F H I

S T U V : T S U V

W X Y Z : X Y W Z

options.text: A B C D : B A C D
options.html: A B C D : B A C D

options.text: M N O P : N M O P
options.html: M N O P : N M O P

options.text: W X Y Z : X Y W Z
options.html: W X Y Z : X Y W Z

options.text: S T U V : T S U V
options.html: S T U V : T S U V

questions.solution:
M N O P → N M O P First two letters swapped: M↔N

A B C D → B A C D First two letters swapped: A↔B

F G H I → G F H I First two letters swapped: F↔G

S T U V → T S U V First two letters swapped: S↔T

W X Y Z → X Y W Z Here, W has moved to the third position , not just swapped with X. The order becomes: X Y W Z — this breaks the consistent swap pattern.

Correct answer: W X Y Z : X Y W Z

questions.question: Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group? SMILE : T N K M F BRING : C S J O H FLOUR : G M P V S HOUSE : I P V T F TRUTH : U S V U I
questions.questionHtml:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

SMILE : T N K M F

BRING : C S J O H

FLOUR : G M P V S

HOUSE : I P V T F

TRUTH : U S V U I

options.text: TRUTH : U S V U I
SMILE : T N K M F
FLOUR : G M P V S
HOUSE : I P V T F

questions.solution:
1. SMILE → T N K M F

Letters of SMILE:

S → T (+1)

M → N (+1)

I → K (+2)

L → M (+1)

E → F (+1)

✅ Mostly consistent: +1 shift, with one +2

2. BRING → C S J O H

B → C (+1)

R → S (+1)

I → J (+1)

N → O (+1)

G → H (+1) ✅ All +1 shifts

3. FLOUR → G M P V S

F → G (+1)

L → M (+1)

O → P (+1)

U → V (+1)

R → S (+1) ✅ All +1 shifts

4. HOUSE → I P V T F

H → I (+1)

O → P (+1)

U → V (+1)

S → T (+1)

E → F (+1) ✅ All +1 shifts

5. TRUTH → U S V U I

T → U (+1)

R → S (+1)

U → V (+1)

T → U (+1)

H → I (+1) ✅ All +1 shifts

Conclusion:

All pairs except SMILE → T N K M F follow a consistent +1 shift for each letter. SMILE has a deviation with I → K (+2) .

✅ Odd one out: SMILE : T N K M F

It breaks the uniform +1 pattern.

Correct answer: SMILE : T N K M F
